extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux). Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that scans the active note for image references and inserts recognized text below each image.
problem: Users need a way to extract text from images within Obsidian notes without sending data to external servers or using API keys.
summary: TextLens scans active notes for images and inserts recognized text below each image using on-device OCR.
